title: Bone Graft Displacement After Maxillary Sinus Floor Augmentation With or Without Covering Barrier Membrane: A Retrospective Computed Tomographic Image Evaluation
authors: Ohayon L, Taschieri S, Friedmann A, Del Fabbro M. Int J Oral Maxillofac Implants. 2019; 34(3):681–691.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The authors concluded that a barrier membrane placed over the lateral bone window helped preventing bone graft particles displacement thus reducing post-operative morbidity” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
